test_format_sse_end_event: test the format_sse function to produce an SSE frame with data: null for end events
test_format_sse_metadata_event: test the format_sse function to produce an SSE frame with event and id fields for metadata events
test_format_sse_error_event: test the format_sse function to produce an SSE frame with message and name fields for error events
test_format_sse_with_event_id: test the format_sse function includes the optional event_id field in the SSE frame output
test_format_sse_data_serialization: test the format_sse function serializes arbitrary data payloads as JSON in the SSE data field
